verdict.rationale: Bento documents broad programmatic coverage. This includes subscriber import and search, events, broadcast creation and scheduling, transactional email, a Chat API, data deletion requests, and fields and tags set via the API. A CLI also claims to manage the 'entire Bento account', but no doc states full API–UI parity, and several UI features have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API endpoints for building visual workflows, segments, forms and templates, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
